status: completion of methods prespecified in sp500_experiment_design_v1.json; constructed after 12G outcomes were viewed
direct_rule: among firms meeting either directional seed flag, assign each firm exclusively to the sign of its pre-existing net_score; exclude exact zero ties; long positive net scores and short negative net scores
embedding_rule: exclude all direct seeds; signed score equals strongest positive propagation minus strongest negative propagation; select top positive and bottom negative scores using corresponding covered seed counts
hybrid_rule: equal-weight average of within-vintage z-scored direct net text score and signed embedding propagation score; select corresponding positive and negative covered-seed counts
hybrid_long_only_rule: 50 percent direct-positive sleeve and 50 percent positive embedding-discovery sleeve
return_convention: firm buy-and-hold, then equal weight within legs
